underdog.heading: Why Texas Southern can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 -7.9 to p90 +37.1 for UTEP, so a projection of +16.1 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
